name: Goodang Bouldering
address: Jl. Terusan Kopo Katapang KM 12,2 No. 106, Kabupaten Bandung, Jawa Barat 40921

coord_source.ref: Google Maps embed pin on goodangbouldering.com (!2d107.5518536!3d-6.9972186)

research_notes: Bouldering gym just south-west of Bandung city (Katapang), with a Kilter Board and a cafe. The site is a script-rendered app: hours (daily 10:00-22:00), the self-description as a bouldering gym and the map pin are all in the page code. Open status rests on this site only; it was reachable and current on the access date.

name: Bali Boulder
address: Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No. 524, Sanur Kauh, Denpasar Selatan, Denpasar
research_notes: New bouldering-only hub (20 m wall) housed at the Clip n Climb Bali site on the Sanur bypass. Page shows a soft opening in August plus daily hours 09:00-21:00; marked open on that basis, the reviewer may want to confirm it is fully open. Clip n Climb itself is a rope-based fun-climbing park and is not listed.

name: Boulder Climbing Gym Boxies 123
address: Boxies 123 Mall lantai 5, Jl. Raya Tajur No. 123, Katulampa, Bogor Timur, Kota Bogor 16141

coord_source.ref: Google Maps embed on the Boxies123 mall contact page (mall pin, not the gym)

research_notes: Indoor climbing area on the 5th floor of the mall, open daily 10:00-21:00 per the mall page. The mall page itself only says indoor climbing and never lists disciplines; local news (not primary) says it has lead, speed, bouldering and fun walls. Bouldering therefore left as unknown, and types holds only the lead wall mentioned by that news. Coordinates are the mall pin.

name: Bali Climbing Bouldering Gym Canggu
address: Jl. Munduk Catu, Batu Bolong, Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361
research_notes: Open-air bouldering gym with cafe near Batu Bolong beach. Its old site (bali-climbing.com, still tagged in OSM) now redirects to an unrelated gambling page, so website is left empty and current opening status could not be confirmed from a primary source. OSM has two features for it (node 5666666835 and way 1069153291, about 30 m apart).
